label: derived fixtures; not experimental evidence (fragments and renamings of a public entry, not observed structures)
common_rule: Only model 1, chain A, group ATOM rows with one of the 20 standard residue names are used (1MQ4 has no altlocs or insertion codes there); coordinates, occupancy and B are copied (PDB files format them %8.3f/%6.2f). Each fragment's residue numbers are contiguous in the source. PDB files start with REMARK 999 lines naming them as derived fixtures and have no HEADER (no PDB id is claimed).
purpose: M15 residue numbering tests: structures without label_seq_id, MSE, insertion codes, several chains and non-first models; each fragment aligns to UniProt O14965 at >=98% identity and 100% structure coverage

files.purpose: (a) PDB format without SEQRES (no label_seq_id), contiguous kinase-domain fragment incl. hinge, catalytic loop and DFG
files.extraction_rule: chain A model 1 ATOM rows of residues 200-285 re-formatted to PDB columns; atom serials renumbered from 1; TER; END

files.purpose: (b) mmCIF with a HETATM MSE inside the chain and the full entity sequence (label_seq_id kept)
files.extraction_rule: _entity/_entity_poly/_struct_asym minimal; _entity_poly_seq rows of entity 1 verbatim except num 181 MET->MSE; _atom_site header verbatim; chain A model 1 ATOM rows of residues 288-360 verbatim except residue 300: group_PDB HETATM, comp MSE, atom SD->SE with type_symbol SE (tokens joined by one space)

files.purpose: (b) PDB format with SEQRES (full entity 1, MSE at 181) + MODRES and a HETATM MSE inside the chain
files.extraction_rule: as the .cif but PDB columns; SEQRES = entity 1 sequence with MSE; MODRES 1MQ4 MSE A 300 MET
as (a) but residue 241 written as 240A (resSeq 240, iCode A); no SEQRES
chain A = residues 200-285; chain B = source chain A residues 126-199 relabeled B (real coordinates, no transform)
MODEL 1 = chain A residues 126-199; MODEL 2 = chain A residues 200-285
